title: MemoryMint
tagline: MemoryMint: Your travel companion in the web3 world. Mint Voyage NFTs, preserve memories on Lens, and earn DeFi rewards. Travel. Share. Collect. #Blockchain #TravelNFT #DeFi
description: MemoryMint is a cutting-edge web3 DApp designed to empower travelers to immortalize their journeys as cherished NFT memories. With MemoryMint, adventurers can mint unique Voyage NFTs that represent their trips, including destinations, start and end dates. These personalized tokens serve as a testament to their travel experiences and can be enriched with photos, videos, and audio memories posted through Lens Protocol. Authenticated through Worldcoin verification, travelers can confidently share their stories on Lens and even set prices to monetize their content. With DeFi rewards powered by Superfluid, MemoryMint offers an unparalleled opportunity for verified users to turn their passion for travel into sustainable income streams. Explore, mint, and collect unforgettable memories with MemoryMint today!
how_its_made:
MemoryMint is built on cutting-edge web3 technologies, combining smart contracts and decentralized protocols to create a seamless travel experience:

1. Smart Contracts: Solidity with Hardhat is used to develop the core smart contracts for minting Voyage NFTs on Polygon Mumbai.

2. Lens Protocol & API: MemoryMint leverages Lens Protocol as a decentralized photo sharing platform, integrated through the Lens API for content registration.

3. Worldcoin Verification: Ensuring authenticity, users undergo verification with Worldcoin to prevent misuse.

4. Superfluid & DeFi Rewards: Verified Travelers set prices to collect content generated during their travels and earn DeFi rewards via Superfluid's income streams.

5. The Graph & Indexing: The Graph is employed to index data from Voyage NFTs, tracking user trips and ownership details.

6. Web3 DApp: MemoryMint's frontend is powered by Nuxt.js with Tailwind CSS, and Wallet Connect enables interaction with Web3 wallets.

7. IPFS: The InterPlanetary File System stores and retrieves media files related to trips for robust data management.

8. Gnosis PoAP: Gnosis facilitates PoAP functionality for minting trip NFTs and validating real-person ownership.

MemoryMint is a fusion of blockchain innovation, creating a unique travel platform for sharing, preserving, and earning from cherished memories.
